value.rationale: Graph spread is a natural nontrivial Lipschitz extremal statistic; the triangular Johnson graphs form a classical, highly symmetric infinite metric family. The result proves a sharp all-n isoperimetric-style variance bound with all equality functions and translates this to exact Euclidean inradii, counts of touching facets and a large n(n-3)/2-dimensional incenter family, properties not obtained by mere reparametrization of the general polar duality. Its geometric and graph-theoretic consequences are useful benchmarks for finite transportation geometry.
